content: {"rule":"K-G4","applies":"no","applies_why":"The judge text lists links L1 to L3 with verses and Greek terms but has no 'cited in' line and never calls any verse an unanswered witness, so it does not do what the rule governs.","verdict":"CLEAN","quote":"[L3] Luke 1:34.","rule_words":"A verse on a side's 'cited in' line counts as an unanswered witness only when the judge quotes the sentence of the earlier round that pressed it against that link or a listed premise and names that round","room":"none","why":"Without any 'cited in' verse treated as an unanswered witness, the rule's requirement to quote and name an earlier round is never triggered, so nothing breaches it."}
